messages.subject: Fall Stats Camp in London
parts:
Hello lavaan enthusiasts,

Anyone looking to spice up a long weekend in October with a 3-day course in London?  We offer 8 topics covering various latent-variable models (SEM and multilevel modeling) and other advanced procedures (e.g., meta-analysis, missing data):

Introduction to Bayesian Statistics: Rethinking Statistics
– Instructor, Rens Van De Schoot, Ph.D.

Introduction to Multilevel Modeling (MLM)
– Instructor, Terrence Jorgensen, Ph.D.

Introduction to Stata for the Behavioral Sciences
– Instructor, Chuck Huber, Ph.D.

Longitudinal Structural Equation Modeling (SEM)
– Instructors, Todd D. Little, Ph.D. & Elizabeth Grandfield, Ph.D.

Missing Data Analysis
– Instructor, Kyle Lang, Ph.D.

PLS Path Modeling using ADANCO and SmartPLS
– Instructor, Joerg Hensler, Ph.D.

Program Evaluation and Cost Benefit Analysis
– Instructor, Mwarumba Mwavita, Ph.D.

Psychometrics
– Instructor, Matthew A. Diemer, Ph.D.

Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
– Instructor, Joshua R. Polanin, Ph.D.


You can find details at our web site (or the attached flyer):

https://www.statscamp.org/london-camp


Feel free to forward the link to any colleagues you have who might be looking for a gentle introduction into an advanced topic to strengthen their methodological skills.

Thanks!

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen
